description.en: Self-hosted plugin index for dsh-backup: configuration backup, per-version store of the dsh install, and a pre-write purge gate.
description.zh: dsh-backup 自建插件索引：配置备份、dsh 本体多版本库、写前 purge 闸门。

description.en: 3-layer config protection (versioned snapshot/restore, fail-closed purge gate, ACL deny) plus a per-version store of the dsh installation with one-command switch, so a purge-incompatible dsh update can be rolled back. Host-only bundle, 7 tools.
description.zh: 三层配置保护（版本化快照/恢复、写前 fail-closed 闸门、ACL 拒绝）+ dsh 本体多版本库与一键切换，让不兼容 purge 的 dsh 升级可回退。Host-only bundle，7 个工具。
